dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I might've heard a thing or two.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Ooh! That means you must've read the "Aranara" picture book series too, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: Setaria brought me lots and lots of those books so that I can read them and learn words at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I thought that I might have trouble understanding them, but turns out that this stuff is super interesting!

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I just, uh... Sometimes, I get too excited to see the ending and read too fast, so I end up forgetting to record some words that I don't know yet...

dialogues.speaker: Ramiz
dialogues.text: I'll ask Setaria the next time I see her, though!
